Un titular de regulacion (un regulador britanico citando el hackeo viejo de Binance para pedir reglas DeFi mas duras, hace 4 horas) es riesgo de fondo, no gatillo de hoy.

Califique el dia de ayer (26 de noviembre): el sesgo automatico acerto en el cierre con movimientos chicos pero fallo en la corrida de NY cuando el precio se enfrio; de las zonas, solo la compra de continuacion de BTC funciono (r 1.04), el resto se rompio o no se toco. Los priores de contexto de hoy (fondeo neutral 20%, miedo extremo 20%, DVOL bajando 11%) siguen muy por debajo del 40% que haria falta para subir la conviccion.
Sin GO en ninguna de las dos: WAIT se mantiene en las dos, sin borde a tiro todavia.
en: Both coins cooled off overnight and closed back inside their own no-trade zone for the day: ETH trades at 1,702.10 (zone 1,687.46 to 1,702.51) and BTC at 60,803.60 (zone 60,570.63 to 60,941.72), both glued to VWAP and their 20/50-EMA cluster.
The net 24-hour move deflated completely on both coins (ETH -0.01%, was +5.15% yesterday; BTC +0.08%, was +5.68%): with no net direction, the method leaves no zone at A+ today, only B.

Two levels mapped per coin: a buy floor in yesterday's discount pocket (1,683.46 to 1,691.65 on ETH, confluence 8; 60,280.38 to 60,577.18 on BTC, confluence 6) and a sell ceiling at today's/overnight's/Asia's high cluster (1,703.62 to 1,714.49 on ETH, confluence 8; 60,842.45 to 61,257.00 on BTC, confluence 6). Neither has been touched yet.

Funding is neutral on both coins (no crowded shorts to add the method's extra point), extreme fear deepens a bit further to 12 (was 11), DVOL keeps falling (65.8 ETH, 52.2 BTC) and there's no ETH CME gap this week. A regulatory headline (a UK regulator citing Binance's old hack to push for tougher DeFi rules, 4 hours old) is background risk, not today's trigger.

Graded yesterday (November 26): the automatic bias call hit on the close run with small moves but missed on the NY run when price cooled off; of the zones, only BTC's continuation buy worked (r 1.04), the rest either broke or never got touched. Today's context priors (neutral funding 20%, extreme fear 20%, falling DVOL 11%) all sit well under the 40% bar that would raise conviction.
No GO on either coin: WAIT holds on both, with no edge in reach yet.

counterCase.es: Si BTC cierra una vela de 15 minutos sobre 61,257.00 sin barrer primero, o bajo 60,280.38 sin reclamar, el balance se rompe de verdad y el siguiente imán seria el PDH (61,622.38) arriba o el PDL (59,915.00) abajo, con presupuesto de sobra (solo 12% del ATR diario usado). Cuentas largas de BTC en 2.47 a 1 todavia estan lejos del corte de riesgo de 3 a 1.
counterCase.en: If BTC closes a 15-minute candle above 61,257.00 without sweeping first, or below 60,280.38 without reclaiming, the balance truly breaks and the next magnet would be the PDH (61,622.38) above or the PDL (59,915.00) below, with plenty of budget left (only 12% of the daily ATR used). BTC's long-skewed accounts at 2.47 to 1 are still far from the 3-to-1 risk cutoff.
